sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope This document provides a comprehensive explanation of model serialization attacks in machine learning systems, their potential impacts, and how the ModelScan tool helps detect them. It covers the mechanisms behind these attacks, the vulnerable serialization formats, and best practices for secure model handling.

sources.title: Opensource Tool Modelscan Protects AI Models from Serialization Attacks
sources.snippet: ModelScan is an open-source large language model security scanning tool designed to detect potential malicious code within machine learning models, preventing model serialization attacks. It supports various model formats and frameworks, allowing integration into ML Pipelines or CI/CD Pipelines.
